name: UI Widgets & Tactical Systems
summary: Good overall implementation with some mismatches between design docs and code. CommandBar includes a REPORTS button (F7) that was explicitly removed from the design spec. CombatScreen implements most tactical combat features but is missing some UI elements from the design. GroundCombatScreen closely follows the design. EspionagePanel implements spy mechanics but differs from design in allocation model. InfoPanel and sprites.ts are well-aligned with their purposes.

matches.description: 15x15 hex grid size matches design spec (GRID_COLS = 15, GRID_ROWS = 15)
Range brackets match design (Point Blank ≤1, Close ≤4, Medium ≤8, Long ≤15)
HP bar colors match design: green (>50%), yellow (25-50%), red (<25%)
Initiative strip implemented showing turn order sorted by speed
WAIT and DONE buttons implemented per design spec
Combat speed controls implemented (Slow/Normal/Fast) with multipliers
Floating damage numbers implemented with upward drift animation
Ship destruction explosion effect implemented with particle burst
Three-phase structure matches design: planning → resolving → result
Troop deployment slider implemented per design (1 to max available)
Defeat options (RETURN TO BOMBARDMENT/RETREAT FLEET) match design §4.2
Mission types match design: sabotage, theft, propaganda, infiltration, assassination
Success rate display implemented with color-coded probability bar
Mission history and counter-espionage events displayed
Colony info display shows population, factories, bases, shields, waste per design
Fleet deployment panel shows ships, ETA, accept/cancel buttons

mismatches.design_spec:
### 2.8 ~~Reports Screen~~ (REMOVED)

> **REMOVED (2026-04-12):** F7 Reports was not in MOO1 and was never properly defined.
> The command bar follows MOO1: GAME/DESIGN/FLEET/MAP/RACES/PLANETS/TECH.
> F7 = Tech Screen.
mismatches.actual_impl: CommandBar includes REPORTS button with F7 hotkey: { label: 'REPORTS', fkey: 'F7', screen: 'reports', tooltip: 'Empire Reports — Statistics and graphs' }
mismatches.recommendation: Remove REPORTS from NAV_BUTTONS array. Per design spec, F7 should be TECH screen. Current impl has F7=REPORTS and F4=TECH but design says F7=TECH and no REPORTS button.

mismatches.design_spec:
**HP bars on grid tokens**: Each ship token on the hex grid shows a small HP bar (color coded: green > 50%, yellow 25–50%, red < 25%).
**MP display on grid tokens**: Movement Points remaining shown as `MP:n/max` below each token.
mismatches.actual_impl: HP bars are rendered on ship tokens, but MP is displayed as 'Spd N' (combat speed) instead of remaining movement points per turn. No tracking of used movement points within a round.
mismatches.recommendation: Track movementPointsUsed per ship per round. Display as 'MP: remaining/total' below HP bar. Currently shows static speed stat instead of consumable movement points.

mismatches.design_spec:
**Combat log**: Scrollable event log; damage numbers shown inline (e.g. `-45 dmg`).
**Combat log panel tracks all events.**
mismatches.actual_impl: Combat log is rendered but with reversed order (newest first). Design mockup shows chronological order (Round 3 at top, Round 2 below). Log entries also use different format than design.
mismatches.recommendation: Display log in chronological order (oldest at top, newest at bottom with auto-scroll) to match the design wireframe visual.

mismatches.design_spec:
### Animation Speed Options
```
( ) Slow (2x time)
(•) Normal
( ) Fast (0.5x time)
( ) Instant (no animations)
```
mismatches.actual_impl: SPEED_MULTIPLIERS only defines slow/normal/fast but code lacks 'instant' option in the combat screen (only in GroundCombatScreen). CombatScreen has no instant mode toggle.
mismatches.recommendation: Add 'instant' to GameSpeed type and SPEED_MULTIPLIERS. Add instant speed button to combat controls that skips animations entirely.

mismatches.design_spec: **Missiles in flight**: `[3 in flight]` shown in weapon list; missile tokens (~M~) appear on the hex grid and advance each round.
mismatches.actual_impl: No missile tracking system implemented. WeaponInstance has category 'beam' but no missile flight tracking, in-flight token rendering, or point defense auto-fire. All weapons resolve instantly.
mismatches.recommendation: Implement missile tracking: add 'missile' category weapons, track in-flight missiles with positions, render ~M~ tokens on grid, advance per round, implement point defense interception.

mismatches.design_spec:
### Targeting Overlay (On Grid)
E₁ = Target 1 (85% hit) - RED glow
E₂ = Target 2 (70% hit) - ORANGE glow
mismatches.actual_impl: Targetable enemies all get the same red border highlight. No hit chance gradient (red vs orange) based on accuracy.
mismatches.recommendation: Color-code targetable ship highlights based on hit chance: red for high chance, orange for medium, yellow for low.

mismatches.design_spec:
**CRITICAL HIT! ×2 damage**
... CRIT indicator with floating damage
mismatches.actual_impl: spawnDamageNumber has isCrit parameter and shows ✦ prefix, but no critical hit mechanic is implemented in resolveWeaponAttack. Critical hits never actually occur.
mismatches.recommendation: Implement critical hit mechanic in combat system (e.g., roll 95-100 = critical, double damage) and pass isCrit=true to spawnDamageNumber.

mismatches.design_spec:
Active Spy Summary:
  Offensive Spies: 4 (funded by SPYING budget)
  Counter-Intel: 2 (funded by SECURITY budget)
  (Each agent costs ~5 BC/turn to maintain)
mismatches.actual_impl: Spy allocation uses a simple percentage slider (0-100%) of a flat pool (capped at 25 total spies). No BC/turn maintenance cost, no SPYING/SECURITY budget integration.
mismatches.recommendation: Integrate spy allocation with empire SPYING/SECURITY budget from PLANETS screen spending panel. Calculate spy count from budget (budget / 5 BC per spy).

mismatches.actual_impl: Troop bar color transitions work but bar shows currentTroops/totalTroops ratio against INITIAL total, not remaining. After casualties, the bar represents remaining/initial which is correct.
mismatches.recommendation: This is actually correct implementation. No change needed.
